verdicts.reason: Both break the product graphic: the cream circle behind the can has come loose and sits clipped in the bottom-left corner, leaving an orange-on-orange can outline that barely shows. A is a little better. Its can is larger, and the two-line headline, 'Out now.' and the CTA have even gaps, though a wide empty gutter sits between the can and the text. B shrinks the can further and puts too much space between the headline and 'Out now.'. Its one-line headline also crowds the 'Try It' button, which sits only about 12px from the right edge.
